description: On the countertop in front of you are a red ball near the left hand, a yellow cup standing upright near the back, and a metal tray with a padlock on it, plus a small toy and a white block nearby. The right hand reaches forward toward the yellow cup, grasps it as a right-hand object, lifts it, and moves it down and slightly left to place it upright onto the metal tray, then releases; the left hand stays near the red ball without picking it up.
